text:
Oliver (sales): Heads-up — customer Org org-9876 is hitting fair-share queues in eu-west1 during a scheduled live demo at 11:30 UTC. They're asking for a short smoothing window (30m) instead of a full quota bump. Can we do a minimally invasive change? 
Marie (support): Thanks — can you paste org id, expected peak rps/tokens, and exact window? Also any contractual reason we must avoid a temporary override? 
Oliver (sales): org-9876, demo 11:30-12:00 UTC, peak ~75 concurrent requests, ~120k tokens/minute, trial account (no reserved capacity). They want graceful smoothing to avoid many 429s — don't want a permanent uplift. 
Jason (eng-infra): We can apply a short smoothing delta in admission-control: increase fair-share weight for org-9876 in eu-west1 and bump soft queue depth to 200 for 30m. Risk: small impact on other trial traffic. If you confirm window I can run the change. 
Taylor (sre): Also recommend enable fallback routing to eu-west2 for low-priority responses so latency stays stable. Add a short-lived cache bypass to avoid warm-up penalties. 
Marie (support): Customer ok with fallback to eu-west2. Approving 30m window starting at 11:25 UTC to cover pre-demo warmup. 
Jason (eng-infra): I'll run a controlled smoothing and monitor. Command I'm going to run: 
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/admission/smoothing" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"org_id":"org-9876","region":"eu-west1","duration_minutes":30,"queue_depth":200,"fairshare_weight":3,"fallback_regions":["eu-west2"]}'
``` 
Jason (eng-infra): Will watch queue depth, token/s, and eviction metrics. If we see >5% error rate we roll back immediately. 
capacity-bot: Quota smoothing task created: id=qs-20260318-42 for org-9876 window=30m region=eu-west1 status=queued 
Jason (eng-infra): Change applied at 11:24:50 UTC. Monitoring now. 
Taylor (sre): Monitoring looks stable so far — latency p95 down from 900ms to 320ms for org-9876. No evictions observed in past 2m. 
Marie (support): Passing note to CS and the customer that smoothing is in place. 
Oliver (sales): Customer says demo is good, thanks team :thumbsup: 
Jason (eng-infra): Smoothing expires at 11:54:50 UTC — I'll post results after expiry. 
capacity-bot: Quota smoothing id=qs-20260318-42 completed at 11:54:50 UTC. summary: peak_tokens=125k/min, avg_latency_p95=350ms, errors=0.8% 
Marie (support): Closing ticket on our side, filing post-action notes for runbook updates. 
Jason (eng-infra): Follow-up: propose a small automated "demo smoothing" playbook for trials to reduce ad-hoc requests. Will draft.
